phase: PRE-CANDIDATE PREPARATION ONLY; NOT A RELEASE
allowed_dependencies: Lean/Std toolchain and this directory's toy modules only
forbidden: Any actual pair_assembly or live candidate compilation/import; copied scientific oleans
source_origin_gate: Enumerate every declaration whose environment module index originates in the exact source modules; never infer origin by public namespace prefix. Include private, generated, unused declarations.
closure_gate: Collect standard axiom closures for every originating declaration; reject any nonallowlisted axiom. Also reject any originating custom axiom declaration even if unused by all public theorems.

toy_expected.ToyClean: ACCEPT; ordinary, private and generated declarations all inventoried
toy_expected.ToyUnusedAxiom: REJECT despite clean public theorem closure; unused public custom axiom inventoried
toy_expected.ToyPrivateAxiom: REJECT; private custom axiom and generated declarations must retain module origin
toy_expected.ToyRestrictionSource: ACCEPT; establishes original private/generated inventory for exact type/import adapter
toy_expected.ToyExchangeAdapted: ACCEPT; only approved import/type replacements, proof/definition bodies preserved; origin map includes private/generated names
toy_expected.ToyExchangeTampered: REJECT source adapter; changed function body even if Lean accepts it
toy_expected.ToyCoverageTampered: REJECT source adapter for changed body
toy_expected.external_axiom_in_import: REJECT if its closure reaches an originating declaration even though axiom originates elsewhere

adapter_gate: Compare exact source after only preregistered import/type-family substitutions. Record every name/module/encoding adapter. Map originating private module prefixes and generated suffixes explicitly. No additional edits accepted.
clean_false_twins: Each detector must accept its clean twin and reject the deliberate corruption; missing modules or zero-declaration inventories fail.
